title: Show HN: Gol – An interactive globe of the other side of everywhere

item.text: An attempt to show our geographical connectedness on this big blue marble.
item.title: Show HN: Gol – An interactive globe of the other side of everywhere

Mirror world
i
Shows every continent moved to the exact opposite side of the Earth. Where a blue outline
overlaps real land, digging straight down from there would bring you out on land. Light
dots mark those spots.
Same latitude and longitude
i
Draws the east–west line (latitude) and the north–south line (longitude) through your pin,
and lists major cities on each. Places on the same latitude get similar day lengths. The
longitude line also runs through your exit point on the far side.
